correctness.rationale: Checked unique four-part gap parametrization, weighted quadratic E and geometric-moment generating-function algebra; independent direct enumeration agreed with coefficients for 52 terms n=4..55. The numerator P has residues 864,32,6,-12 modulo Phi1,Phi2,Phi3,Phi4, all units mod p>=5, so rational GF is reduced in F_p(q). Any eventual period T must have H dividing 1-q^T. Primitive orders 3,4 give 12|T; multiplicity 6 at q=1 forces p^{v_p(T)}>=6, hence 300 at p=5 and 12p for p>=7. Frobenius proves H|1-q^T at those T. Since deg(q^4P)+T-deg(H)=T-6<T, initial coefficients are periodic starting at n=0. Independent recurrence and exact modular comparisons checked primes 5,7,11 for >2 full periods. Thus finite checks supplement the all-prime divisibility proof.

originality.rationale: Ballantine–Beck–Merca 2025 open-access full article explicitly displays numerical period table (300,84,132 etc) as conjectural, proves congruences modulo 2,3,4, and does not prove exact minimum for all primes >=5. Nijenhuis–Wilf and Kwong give general techniques for *unweighted* restricted partition counts; their theorem statements cannot be substituted for this weighted quadratic statistic without establishing its reduced denominator. Best-of-knowledge O PASS for new proof and uniform prime classification, not for the already conjectured table values.
residual_risks: A more general rational-generating-function least-period theorem might imply the result once the specific reduced generating function is known; this would not eliminate value of its exact computation.
